description: Master residue artifact table joining ortholog retention with measured structural distances, plus the three-panel verdict figure
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
R=pd.read_csv("hsp110_vs_hsp70_position_test.csv")
D=pd.read_csv("hsp110_nucleotide_site_distances.csv")
GO=pd.read_csv("Q05036_GO_annotations.csv")
M=R.merge(D[["Hsc70","CeHSP110","Hsc70_ATP_A","Hsc70_K_A","Ce_ATP_A","Ce_K_A","Ce_MG_A","Ce_pLDDT"]],on="Hsc70",how="left")
M=M[["Hsc70","role","subset","CeHSP110","Hsp110_pct","Hsp70_pct","q_BH","Hsc70_ATP_A","Ce_ATP_A","Hsc70_K_A","Ce_K_A","Ce_MG_A","Ce_pLDDT"]]
M.columns=["Hsc70_pos","structural_role","site_subregion","Ce_HSP110_residue","pct_49_nematode_Hsp110","pct_40_nematode_Hsp70","q_BH","Hsc70_dist_ATP_A","Ce_dist_ATP_A","Hsc70_dist_K_A","Ce_dist_K_A","Ce_dist_MG_A","Ce_pLDDT"]
M=M.round(2)
M.to_csv("ARTIFACT_residue_map_table.csv",index=False)
print("=== ARTIFACT: master residue table (26 Hsc70 nucleotide-site positions) ===")
print(M.to_string(index=False))

print("\n=== ARTIFACT: QuickGO record, Q05036 ===")
print(GO.to_string(index=False))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15.5,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
order=["adenosine/ribose + anchors","catalytic Lys/Glu","K+ coordination shell","beta/gamma-phosphate region"]
m110=[R[R.subset==s].Hsp110_pct.mean() for s in order]; m70=[R[R.subset==s].Hsp70_pct.mean() for s in order]
y=np.arange(4)
ax.barh(y+0.2,m70,0.4,color="#1f6f4a",label="nematode Hsp70s (n=40)")
ax.barh(y-0.2,m110,0.4,color="#c0392b",label="nematode Hsp110s (n=49)")
ax.set_yticks(y);ax.set_yticklabels(["adenosine/ribose\npocket + anchors","catalytic Lys/Glu\n(K71, E175)","K+ coordination\nshell","beta/gamma-phosphate\ncontacts"],fontsize=8.5)
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(m110,m70)):
    ax.text(a+1.5,i-0.2,f"{a:.0f}%",va="center",fontsize=8); ax.text(b+1.5,i+0.2,f"{b:.0f}%",va="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0,112);ax.set_xlabel("mean % of orthologs carrying the Hsc70 residue")
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right");ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
ax.set_title("A  Loss is confined to the catalytic half of the site",fontsize=9.5,loc="left")

ax=axes[1]
ax.bar(["Hsc70\n1KAX","Sse1\n2QXL","Ce HSP-110\nAF v6 model"],[6,1,1],color=["#1f6f4a","#c0392b","#c0392b"],width=0.55)
ax.set_ylabel("protein ligands of the catalytic K+ within 3.2 A");ax.set_ylim(0,7.2);ax.set_yticks(range(8))
for i,v in enumerate([6,1,1]): ax.text(i,v+0.12,str(v),ha="center",fontsize=11)
ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
ax.set_title("B  The K+ cofactor cage is dismantled",fontsize=9.5,loc="left")

ax=axes[2]
cats=["ATP binding\n(adenosine pocket)","Mg2+ ligation\n(D7, D204)","catalytic Lys/Glu\n(K68, E175)","K+ cofactor\nshell","beta/gamma-PO4\nThr pair","Hsp70 allosteric\nlinker 383-397","Sse1 NEF interface\n(3C7N, 53 res)"]
val=[89,100,97,46,1,0,64]
ax.barh(np.arange(7),val,color=["#1f6f4a" if v>=60 else("#e08a1e" if v>=40 else "#c0392b") for v in val],height=0.62)
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(7));ax.set_yticklabels(cats,fontsize=8);ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlim(0,112);ax.set_xlabel("% retained or identical in C. elegans HSP-110")
for i,v in enumerate(val): ax.text(v+1.5,i,f"{v}%",va="center",fontsize=8)
ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
ax.set_title("C  Nucleotide site and NEF surface kept, catalysis lost",fontsize=9.5,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
